Local development

Requirements

PartNeedsInstall (macOS)
EngineCMake 3.16+, a C++17 compilerbrew install cmake (Xcode supplies clang)
Apple appsmacOS 14+, Xcode 15+, XcodeGenbrew install xcodegen
Android appJDK 17, Android SDK, NDK, CMake 3.22.1 (via SDK manager), Gradle 8.11Android Studio
Checks and siteNode 20+, Python 3brew install node
Containers (optional)Docker with ComposeDocker Desktop

make setup reports which of these are present and generates the Xcode project when XcodeGen is installed.

Everyday commands

CommandDoes
make buildBuilds the engine (CMake) and, on macOS, the Swift package
make testEngine tests (ctest) and, on macOS, swift test
make validateEvery check, then the tests; the same command CI runs
make devmacOS: opens platforms/apple/Soundboard.xcodeproj. Elsewhere: serves the docs site
make tokensRegenerates Swift, CSS and DESIGN.md from design/tokens/obsidian.tokens.json
make siteRegenerates public/ and the root index.html
make site-serveServes public/ at http://localhost:8052/
make demoRuns the routing prototype; writes master, headphone and split WAVs to out/

Apple

make setup                                   # runs xcodegen in platforms/apple
open platforms/apple/Soundboard.xcodeproj

Schemes: Soundboard (the app) and RoutingLab (routing check). Both build for iOS and macOS from one target. To run on an iPhone, set your team under Signing & Capabilities; nothing in the repository holds a team ID. Package.swift at the root builds the engine and Swift targets without Xcode: swift build && swift test.

Android

cd platforms/android
gradle :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:assembleDebug

Open platforms/android in Android Studio to run the Routing Lab on a device. The Android project has not been built yet; see job 009.

Engine only

cmake -S engine -B engine/build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
cmake --build engine/build -j
ctest --test-dir engine/build --output-on-failure

Sanitizer builds are in QA.
